refresh_policy.rule: Mutable external claims must be re-researched and reviewed; CI validates the frozen snapshot structure and identity binding only.

records.observed_claim: FIPS 203 is final, published 2024-08-13; NIST carries a 2025-11-17 planning note that an identified issue is intended for a future update/revision and links potential errata.
records.claim_ceiling: Does not establish correctness of any Xenia provider implementation.

records.observed_claim: FIPS 204 is final, published 2024-08-13; NIST carries a 2026-07-31 planning note pointing to several minor potential errata for a future update/revision.
records.claim_ceiling: Does not establish correctness of any Xenia provider implementation.

records.observed_claim: The crate documentation states that the implementation has never been independently audited.
records.claim_ceiling: Absence of an independent audit is not evidence that the implementation is insecure; it is an assurance gap.

records.observed_claim: The final 0.3.0 changelog records Wycheproof validation additions and fixes for encapsulation-key and expanded-decapsulation-key validation; current observed stable is 0.3.2.
records.claim_ceiling: Do not infer that the rc.2 artifact contains or lacks every final-0.3.0 fix; establish exact ancestry or executable differential evidence before an upgrade/security claim.

records.observed_claim: The crate documentation states that the implementation has never been independently audited.
records.claim_ceiling: This does not negate test, review, or upstream security work; it forbids calling the locked provider independently audited without new evidence.

records.observed_claim: Published affected range is before 0.1.0-rc.3; patched versions begin at 0.1.0-rc.3.
records.claim_ceiling: Outside a published affected range is not a general constant-time or security proof.

records.observed_claim: Published affected versions are through 0.1.0-rc.3; patched versions begin at 0.1.0-rc.4.
records.claim_ceiling: Does not prove canonical signature handling beyond this published advisory range.

records.observed_claim: Published affected versions are through 0.1.0-rc.4; patched version is 0.1.0-rc.5.
records.claim_ceiling: Does not prove FIPS compliance or absence of other implementation defects.

records.observed_claim: Project documentation reports CBMC memory/type-safety proofs for its C code and HOL Light functional-correctness, memory-safety, and secret-independent-timing proofs for AArch64/x86_64 assembly, with separate soundness/scope documentation and other side-channel classes out of scope.
records.claim_ceiling: Proofs apply to the documented mlkem-native implementation/boundaries, not RustCrypto ML-KEM, Xenia integration, FFI safety, or the Xenia protocol.

records.observed_claim: Project documentation reports hax/F* verification for portable and AVX2 portions covering field/NTT arithmetic, serialization, and generic high-level algorithms, with claims including panic freedom, correctness, and secret independence for documented code paths.
records.claim_ceiling: Bind an exact release/commit and proof coverage before using as qualification evidence; project-level verification does not transfer to Xenia automatically.

records.observed_claim: A 2026 advisory reports an AVX2 ML-DSA verification edge-case bug in libcrux-ml-dsa versions before 0.0.9, patched in 0.0.9.
records.claim_ceiling: A formally verified project may still contain uncovered, incorrectly modeled, or regressed boundaries; exact release and proof coverage remain mandatory.

records.observed_claim: The HACL*/EverCrypt supported-algorithms table states it lists algorithms for which verification is complete and includes Ed25519, SHA2-256/384/512, HKDF, ChaCha20-Poly1305, and Poly1305 among the supported verified implementations.
records.claim_ceiling: Useful for independent cross-vectors/reference comparison; not evidence that Xenia's Rust providers are themselves verified.

required_followups: Bind exact source commit ancestry for ml-kem 0.3.0-rc.2 versus final 0.3.0 validation/vector changes.
Build deterministic ML-KEM cross-provider vectors against at least one independently version-pinned oracle.
Add ML-DSA regression vectors for published 2026 advisory classes against the locked 0.1.1 provider.
Keep constant-time/compiled-target evidence separate from functional correctness and advisory-range checks.
Require native/WASM transcript and key-schedule conformance independently of primitive-provider evidence.
non_equivalences: published advisory range says not affected != independently audited
formal proof of provider component != proof of provider integration != proof of Xenia protocol
cross-provider vector agreement != computational security proof
newer provider version != stronger assurance until requalified
external evidence snapshot != live current truth after its review horizon
